title: Finite torsion-free rank is equivalent to absence of infinite-cyclic wreath sections for finitely generated soluble groups with Krull dimension
author: Lison Jacoboni; Peter Kropholler
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.51

difficulty_reason: The proof uses constrained rational modules, a semisimple locally finite action decomposition, and finite-dimensional support of extension cohomology to force infinitely many independent finite-rank module factors, contradicting ordinal Krull dimension. These soluble-group and homological tools exceed ordinary qualifying examinations.
